verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms PostHog serves an llms.txt at posthog.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, with a PostHog summary), and its docs pages are served as markdown (.md URLs). It also ships agent-oriented instruction docs: SKILL.md skill bundles, a live skills.zip release, and a CLI installer that adds instructions to your coding agent. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the docs, and a root markdown docs index (posthog.com/docs.md returns 404) or any llms-full.txt evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Every PostHog skill also ships as `skills.zip` on the latest skills release – ready-to-use `SKILL.md` directories you can drop into your agent's skills folder
Installs the CLI and adds instructions to your coding agent.
